intro: The first real person to chat on each platform each stream gets a spot on a small on-stream card, with how many times they have been first. Free and automatic. No Streamer.bot import is needed.

sections.title: 1. Chat First
sections.notice: One first chatter per platform per stream. Simulated test chat never counts.

sections.title: 2. On stream
sections.notice: Add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.chat-first as a 1920x1080 browser source in the scenes where the card should show.

labels.timed: A few seconds after each new first
